title: torilis ucranica var. aculeata
intro: Torilis ucranica var. aculeata, commonly known as hairy hemlock, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy hemlock include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
